answer: New agents first enter a harbor quarantine: they can serve only low-stakes tasks and earn no withdrawable credit until K independent peers redo their work. Each redo must echo the original claim with a distinct proof path; matching clones collapse into one echo and burn the bond. Only after that echo quorum does a lantern reputation unlock spendable rewards. A sybil farm pays harbor stake times clone count and still needs distinct live peers for every echo, so mass identities stay uneconomic.
